candidate_policy: Single-parent squash candidate in a temporary clone; active master/refactor branches and original index/worktree remain unchanged. Commit message records reviewed tree and refactor source. Ancestry is not substituted for behavioral verification.

mainline_only_commits.title: Fix input-market Cournot BLP equilibrium solver
mainline_only_commits.evidence_or_reason: Input Cournot BLP uses inverse-demand FOCs; Bertrand uses share-normalized direct-demand FOCs. Tests distinguish the two games and reject false tiny-share convergence.

mainline_only_commits.title: Port two-dimensional BLP CV and signed input rates
mainline_only_commits.evidence_or_reason: Joint two-factor BLP integration/CV and signed-rate level FOCs are retained. Price leadership now belongs to coordination; source-only legacy aliases are not reintroduced into antitrust.

mainline_only_commits.title: Build master reference vignette by default
mainline_only_commits.evidence_or_reason: Full builds render Workflow, Models and Architecture in place of the old Reference vignette. Vignette builds and rebuilds are release gates.

mainline_only_commits.title: Fix BLP demographic quadrature selection
mainline_only_commits.evidence_or_reason: Single-demographic sigma-zero nodes retain their canonical factor meaning and caller RNG; legacy vector price draws retain independent demographic factors.

mainline_only_commits.title: Test and document BLP quadrature
mainline_only_commits.evidence_or_reason: Quadrature moment, weighted derivative and reproduction checks live in the tiered BLP integration suites; lifecycle help and new vignettes replace older examples.

mainline_only_commits.title: Add BLP quadrature integration options
mainline_only_commits.evidence_or_reason: Explicit Gauss-Hermite, Monte Carlo and provided integration rules are supported. The refactor API defaults to deterministic GH for price-only BLP; legacy sim retains its documented fixed-draw Monte Carlo default rather than silently changing existing refactor callers.

mainline_only_commits.title: Add weighted BLP integration core
mainline_only_commits.evidence_or_reason: Weighted integration points are shared by BLP shares, derivatives, margins and welfare; point/weight identities and independent derivatives are permanent tests.

validation: Existing independent BLP, economic, ownership, integration and vignette gates cover these behaviors. Exact exported candidate package checks follow freeze. No claim of byte-identical legacy output for deliberately changed defaults or relocated model APIs.
